tools.name: list_connected_accounts
tools.description: List every social account connected to this LazyRelay account, with platform, display name and the id the posting tools need. Accounts that need reconnecting say so.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List this account's brands (workspaces), with the id needed to file a post under a specific one.

tools.name: get_platform_rules
tools.description: What a platform accepts BEFORE you post: text limit, image and video rules, how many images per post, which fields are required (for example TikTok's privacy level, Pinterest's board), features (stories, threads, first comment) and the options it reads. Pass a platform such as instagram or tiktok, or leave it out for all of them.

platform.description: For example instagram, tiktok, pinterest, youtube. Leave out for all platforms

tools.name: get_tiktok_creator_info
tools.description: For one connected TikTok account: the privacy levels it can use, whether comments, duets and stitches are allowed, and the longest video. Call this before posting to TikTok, because tiktokPrivacyLevel is required and must be one of the levels returned.

socialAccountId.description: A TikTok account id from list_connected_accounts

annotations.title: Check what a TikTok account allows

tools.name: list_pinterest_boards
tools.description: For one connected Pinterest account: its boards with their ids. A Pinterest post needs a boardId from this list.

socialAccountId.description: A Pinterest account id from list_connected_accounts

tools.name: get_next_free_slot
tools.description: The account's next free posting time for one connected account, from the posting times saved in Settings. Returns an ISO timestamp to use as scheduledFor. Says so plainly if no posting times are saved.

socialAccountId.description: The connected account id, from list_connected_accounts

annotations.title: Find the next free posting time

tools.name: list_posting_slots
tools.description: The posting times saved in Settings (days, time, time zone).

tools.name: list_snippets
tools.description: The account's saved text snippets (hashtag groups, sign-offs) and which one is the signature, to paste into a post.

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule a post to ONE connected account (call once per account to post to several). Use list_connected_accounts for the id and get_platform_rules to see what the platform needs. TikTok needs tiktokPrivacyLevel, Pinterest needs boardId. Set requiresApproval to hold it for a client to approve first.

socialAccountId.description: The connected account id to post to, from list_connected_accounts

scheduledFor.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when to post, in the future

requiresApproval.description: Hold the post until someone approves it (in the dashboard or through a client review link)

mediaUrl.description: A publicly accessible image or video URL to attach

mediaUrls.description: Extra images after mediaUrl for a multi-image post. Call get_platform_rules for how many the platform takes

coverImageUrl.description: A still cover image for a video (Pinterest video pins need one)

mediaAltText.description: Accessibility description of the main image (Mastodon and Bluesky use it)

firstComment.description: A first comment posted right after publishing (Facebook and Instagram only)

tags.description: Up to 5 short labels for filtering analytics by campaign

selfReplyText.description: A follow-up comment added once the post reaches selfReplyAtLikes likes (Facebook and Instagram only)

selfReplyAtLikes.description: The like count that triggers selfReplyText

boardId.description: Pinterest only: the board to pin to. Get it from list_pinterest_boards

destinationLink.description: Pinterest only: where a click on the pin goes

tiktokPrivacyLevel.description: TikTok only, REQUIRED for TikTok: call get_tiktok_creator_info to see which levels the account allows

tiktokDisableComment.description: TikTok only: turn comments off (default true, comments off)

tiktokDisableDuet.description: TikTok only: turn duets off (default true)

tiktokDisableStitch.description: TikTok only: turn stitches off (default true)

tiktokBrandOrganic.description: TikTok only: the video promotes the creator's own brand

tiktokBrandContent.description: TikTok only: the video is a paid partnership

options.description: Platform-specific settings for the account you post to: tiktok {aiGenerated}; youtube {title, privacy public|unlisted|private, madeForKids, tags[], aiGenerated}; instagram {placement feed|reel|story, trialReel, trialGraduation manual|auto}; facebook {placement feed|story}; linkedin {documentUrl (https PDF), documentTitle}; threads, bluesky, mastodon and x {chain: [follow-up texts]} for a thread. Send only the key that belongs to the account's platform.

tools.description: Publish to one connected account right away instead of scheduling. The scheduler picks it up within moments, it is not published synchronously: call list_scheduled_posts afterwards and check verifiedLive to confirm it really went live. Same fields as schedule_post.

tools.name: list_scheduled_posts
tools.description: This account's upcoming and recent posts with their status (draft, needs_approval, pending, posted, failed) and whether each is confirmed live. Returns a short summary of each post; set detail to true for the full records. Filter by status or account to keep it small.

limit.description: At most this many posts, default 50

detail.description: Return the full records instead of the short summary

tools.name: delete_scheduled_post
tools.description: Cancel a pending or waiting-for-approval post before it goes out. Has no effect on a post that has already gone out.

tools.name: get_proof_link
tools.description: A public link that shows a post was really confirmed live, to share with a client. Only works for a post confirmed live, and the API key must be allowed to share proof.

tools.name: approve_post
tools.description: Approve a post that is waiting for approval, so it is scheduled. Only do this when the account owner has asked you to.

tools.name: create_review_link
tools.description: Create a link a client opens (no account needed) to see the posts waiting for approval, approve them, ask for changes and comment. Send them the link at lazyrelay.com/review/<token>. Needs a plan that includes review links.

label.description: Who it is for, for example Acme

brandLabel.description: Only show posts for this brand

expiresInDays.description: Days until the link stops working, default 30

tools.name: list_review_links
tools.description: The account's client review links with their status and how many are allowed on the plan.

tools.name: revoke_review_link
tools.description: Stop a client review link working at once.

tools.name: get_post_feedback
tools.description: The conversation on a post waiting for approval: what the client said, whether they asked for changes, and any replies.

annotations.title: Read client feedback on a post

tools.name: reply_to_post_feedback
tools.description: Add a reply to the client conversation on a post. The client sees it on their review page.

tools.name: get_analytics_summary
tools.description: Post counts, verified-live rate, per-platform breakdown and engagement totals for a recent window. Filter by brand or by a tag to compare campaigns; availableTags lists the tags in use.

tools.name: get_mentions
tools.description: Recent comments on this account's posts, on the platforms that let LazyRelay read them (Facebook, Instagram, Mastodon, Bluesky, YouTube).
